sources.label: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

sources.label: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements Guide
sources.covers: A second roadmap and trophy list; the Chapter 1 meditation warning and activity details.

sources.label: OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List

roadmap.title: Run the story
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters and the named story missions; those 12 trophies award themselves as the credits approach and none of them can be missed. Three habits pay off later: sit for the Chapter 1 balcony meditation when Lucia suggests it (the one deadline in the whole list), WAiNK-scan vehicles and study animals as you first meet them, and keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter, because there is no mission replay and no New Game+.

roadmap.title: Friends and strangers
roadmap.meta: 6 character strands · 8 Strangers & Freaks strands · 1 Silver
roadmap.text: Clear the questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, then finish any 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. All of it re-opens in free-roam after the story, with one exception to respect: Yago's street-racing strand carries a time-sensitive race in Chapter 3, so run it when it appears instead of banking it for later.

roadmap.title: The long Leonida grind
roadmap.text: Work the counters while the map is open: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun win at 14 locations, 20 race wins, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles discovered, 5 bank vaults, one illegal operation per gang, the full map unfogged and the secret one-off trophies. Almost everything here also feeds the 100% checklist, so this stage is where the Platinum is really earned.

roadmap.title: 100%, then the Platinum
roadmap.meta: Gold: A Long Road · then Vice Got a Price!
roadmap.text: After the story the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It asks for roughly 60% of the game — any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges — and nothing on it can be missed. Finish it for the Gold, and the Platinum lands the moment the last of the other 54 is yours.

verification: Every name, description and grade in this fieldbook was cross-checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on all 55 trophies; the visible/hidden split was cross-checked against AlcastHQ. PSN progress targets are the ones PSNProfiles lists. Every step of every guide names the publication it rests on. Where no published guide has confirmed a method yet, the guide says so in plain words and labels the leading idea as unconfirmed rather than dressing a guess up as a location.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum is not a task; it is the receipt for the other 54. Treat this entry as the finish line of the roadmap and work the four stages in order — nothing here can be missed, because everything it needs stays open until it is done.

steps.text: Earn each of the other 54 trophies; this one awards itself automatically the moment the last of them lands.
Single-player only: the list holds no online or DLC trophies, so no multiplayer session is ever required.
Follow the four-stage roadmap in this fieldbook and keep this entry for last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission of Chapter 1 doubles as the first trophy. Start a new game, play Gone Fishing to its end, and the trophy is yours before the story has properly begun — there is no way to walk past it.

steps.text: Begin the story and play the first Chapter 1 mission, Gone Fishing, through to completion.
The trophy pops on its own when the mission ends; it is an automatic story award and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1's closing trophy. Play the chapter's story missions in order and it awards itself as Chapter 2 opens. Before you leave Chapter 1 behind, do the balcony meditation described under Positive Mental Attitude — it is the only moment in the game with a deadline.

steps.text: Finish every story mission of Chapter 1; the trophy lands when the chapter closes and the next begins.
While still in Chapter 1, complete Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house so the possibly-missable trophy stays safe.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's closing trophy, shown here exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks and all. Keep playing the main missions and it pops when the chapter ends. Chapter 2 is also where the two leads can first team up freely, which unlocks several partner trophies.

steps.text: Play Chapter 2's story missions to the end of the chapter; the award is automatic.
After the mission Coffee Break you can call your partner and switch characters — several crime and activity trophies open up from here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3's closing trophy. Automatic when the chapter's missions are done — but mind the clock inside this chapter: a Strangers & Freaks race here is time-sensitive, and two character strands (Randy's and Tyrone's) begin off Chapter 3 missions.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3's story missions; the trophy awards itself as Chapter 4 begins.
Do Yago's 'Race Against Yago' strand when it appears in this chapter — it carries an hourglass icon and is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4's closing trophy. Automatic at the chapter's end. Chapter 4 is also the robbery chapter: its optional mission That's Where The Money Is... unlocks the bank vaults that three crime trophies depend on.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4's story missions; the award pops as the story moves into its final chapter.
Pick up the optional mission That's Where The Money Is... in this chapter to unlock bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The Gold for finishing the campaign's final mission. It awards itself at the end — the only preparation worth making is a manual save beforehand, because the game offers no mission replay and no New Game+, so that save is your only way back into the ending.

steps.text: Play the story to its last main mission and complete it; the Gold is automatic on completion.
Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — with no mission replay, it is the only route back to the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A named-mission trophy inside Chapter 2. Breakfast Run is a main story mission, so it sits directly on the path: finish the mission and the trophy follows automatically — nothing optional feeds into it.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run to its end.
The award is automatic on mission completion and cannot be missed while the story is finished.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Chapter 3's big set-piece mission, The Cartel Heist, carries its own trophy. It is a main story mission, so simply reach it and finish it; the trophy lands with the mission-complete screen.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist through to completion.
Automatic on completion — no side objective inside the heist gates the trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: The trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Another main-path award: play the mission, finish it, and the trophy is yours with nothing extra to collect on the way.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play to its end.
Automatic on mission completion, like every named-mission story trophy in the list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission, has its own trophy. It is on the main path and awards itself when the mission wraps up.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners through to completion.
The trophy pops automatically when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the Chapter 4 mission set at Vice City International Airport. Finish it on the main path and the trophy follows. The airport matters again later: the secret trophy Catch Me If You Can is earned on the same ground, in free-roam.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport, to completion.
Automatic on completion; note the airport for later — a secret trophy is earned there outside the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a late-campaign story mission with its own trophy. Reach it, finish it, and the award is automatic — it is the last of the named-mission trophies before the finale.

steps.text: Play the late-story mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end.
Automatic on mission completion; nothing optional inside the mission affects it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The Gold for the game's 100% checklist — which is kinder than it sounds, asking for roughly three-fifths of everything rather than literally all of it. The checklist only appears after the story, but work done during the story already counts toward it, so the grind of stages 2 and 3 is quietly building this trophy the whole time. Nothing on the checklist can be missed.

steps.text: Finish the story first: the checklist appears afterwards under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, with earlier progress already counted.
Complete any 100 optional missions, scan 200 of the 277 vehicles with WAiNK, and study 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars.
Reach 300 stunts and finish any 70 of the 80 challenges — both beyond what their own trophies ask, so plan the extra margin.
Sweep the fixed items: all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal gang operations, every shooting range and drone race, and Bret's questline.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — every item can be finished in free-roam after the story, so this Gold is a matter of time, not timing.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: A quarter of a thousand stunts, drawn from a pool of 397 scattered across Leonida. The four stunt families are not equal: the 202 under-bridge flights are by far the fastest to chain, so a plane and an afternoon of bridges does most of the work. Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist asks for 300, and the extra 50 are cheaper now than later.

steps.text: Complete any 250 stunts; the pool holds 397 in four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Farm the under-bridge flights first: they are the quickest of the four kinds to accumulate.
Track the running total under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find spots on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Push on to 300 stunts while you are set up for it — the 100% checklist requires 300, not 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: touch each of the game's nine activity types a single time. Most of them are forced on you by the story or by other trophies, so this usually pops on its own; if it has not, the map's Activities filter (the blue dumbbell icons) shows exactly where the missing ones live.

steps.text: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race of any kind, and performing a stunt.
Check which types you have touched under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icons) to find a nearby example of any type still missing.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 of them spread over 12 ranges. Work range by range and weapon by weapon, reading each challenge's own scoring before you start — the gold thresholds differ per weapon class. One warning with teeth: golds unlock ammo cheats, and cheats disable trophies, so leave the cheats untouched until the Platinum is banked.

steps.text: Earn gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations.
Clear one range at a time and check its scoring screen first — each challenge sets its own gold threshold.
Golds unlock the Max Ammo, Infinite Ammo and No Reload cheats; never activate a cheat before the Platinum, because cheats switch trophies off.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: One win at each of the 14 Top Fun drone-race locations — not all 42 races, just a single victory per spot. Smooth lines beat raw pace on these courses; learn a location's gates over two or three attempts rather than forcing the first run.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; there are 42 races in total but only one win per location is required.
Fly clean lines and prioritise the gates over top speed — consistency wins these courses.
Revisit any location until its win lands; locations stay open in free-roam.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty wins, but they must be twenty different events — repeating a favourite race only counts once. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all qualify, and with 40 unique race locations on the map you can pick the twenty that suit your driving rather than fighting the hardest ones.

steps.text: Win 20 different race events; car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count toward the total.
Spread the wins across the map — there are 40 unique race locations, so skip any event that keeps beating you and take another.
Top Fun wins do double duty here and under Top Fun itself, so drone locations are efficient early picks.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal, the angler you meet during Chapter 1. After the Feng Shui mission he starts texting you and marks a fishing spot in purple; follow his short questline to the challenge itself and beat his catch there.

steps.text: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; afterwards he texts you and marks a fishing location with a purple icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline to the head-to-head challenge.
Beat Cal's catch in the challenge to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one of the game's four video games-within-the-game, start to credits. Three of them sit on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth lives on arcade cabinets out in the world. You only need the ending of one — its internal challenges do not matter here.

steps.text: Complete any one arcade game in full — all of its levels, once.
Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 onward.
The fourth game, Bang For Your Buck, is found on arcade machines around Leonida.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and self-starting: in Chapter 3 she calls and texts her home address in Belville, and five quests later the strand — and this trophy — ends. Like every character strand, it stays available after the story, so there is no clock on it.

steps.text: As Lucia, wait for Andy's call in Chapter 3; she texts her home address in Belville and the strand marks itself.
Work through her five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The trophy pops at the end of the final quest; the whole strand remains available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton Rees sends you treasure-diving at seven shipwrecks. His strand starts early (Chapter 1, Key Lento), goes quiet for a stretch of story, then returns — that silence is scripted, not a bug, and the strand waits for you in free-roam afterwards.

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, take Kenton's call; he is marked with a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento.
Dive his 7 shipwrecks: follow the purple treasure-chest markers, sweep the ocean floor with the metal detector, and haul each find back to his shop.
He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason and calling Brian speeds his return); track the strand under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
Everything stays available after the story, so the strand cannot be missed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs run out of the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and unlock off a Chapter 2 story mission. Finish the set and the trophy lands after the last job; the strand stays open after the story.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, the strand marks itself at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Finish Billy's five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The trophy pops after the final job; the strand remains available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full Strangers & Freaks strands — and note the fine print: the named character questlines (Andy, Billy, Randy and friends) do not count toward this Silver, only genuine stranger strands do. One strand needs care: Yago's racing strand has a time-sensitive race in Chapter 3, the closest thing this trophy has to a trap.

steps.text: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands anywhere across Leonida; watch the count in the trophy tracker.
Confirmed strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street racing and Pilot Pete's deliveries; more are still being mapped.
The named character questlines do not count toward this trophy — strands and character arcs are tracked separately.
Run Yago's 'Race Against Yago' when it appears in Chapter 3: it is time-sensitive, and the guides disagree on whether skipping it can lock the strand, so do not test it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List is a shopping list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City. It unlocks off a Chapter 3 mission that also hands you the Key Cloner; from there it is a leisurely strand of spotting, scanning and delivering, all completable after the story.

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner — Randy's strand opens.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (green 'RK' icon); the list lives under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
WAiNK-scan candidate cars to check whether one is on the list before stealing it; clean deliveries pay more, and Vice Beach and Ocean Beach spawn sports cars most often.
The strand stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only demolition work: wreck his Synthetic Labs across Vice City until he hands over the finale that shares this trophy's name. It begins off a Chapter 3 mission and stays available after the story.

steps.text: As Jason, after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs around Vice City.
Destroy the labs through the 'Take Out Kitty Litter' quest until Tyrone issues the second quest, 'Spin On This'.
Finish 'Spin On This' to shut the labs down and pop the trophy; the strand remains available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the one trophy in the list with a deadline. There are 18 meditation spots at 10 locations, and meditating as a pair counts double, which makes the counter easy. The danger is a single Chapter 1 session on the balcony at Jason's house: it vanishes when the chapter ends, and whether the trophy requires it is still unconfirmed. Do it, keep a Chapter 1 save, and the question never matters.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia raises meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house — follow her to the balcony and accept the session.
That balcony session disappears when Chapter 1 ends; whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed, so treat it as required and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; progress is tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Meditate with both Jason and Lucia together (possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2) — a paired session counts twice toward the 18.
For reference, the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 meditations; this warning protects the trophy, not the checklist.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting strand is Jason-only and doubles as 100% content through his 15 Target Decks. One honest caveat: which exact animal triggers this trophy was still being confirmed when this fieldbook was written, so the reliable route is simply to hunt everything Bret asks for — the trophy is somewhere inside his strand.

steps.text: As Jason, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts you and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.
Collect his unique hunting rifle, the 'Killtelligence SM-69', from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Hunt the animals he marks with purple icons and bring them back to him; track his requests under Map > Activities > Target Deck.
UNCONFIRMED: the exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed, so work through his whole strand — his 15 Target Decks are also required for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are dealt into 18 sets across Leonida; finishing any three sets in full earns the Silver. There is no partial credit — a set counts when its last card is picked up — so pick sets whose cards cluster along routes you already travel and let the in-game collectible tracking show you what is missing.

steps.text: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets; a set only counts once every card in it is found.
Use the in-game collectibles tracking to see which sets you have finished and which cards remain.
Choose sets whose cards cluster near places you already visit for other trophies, to cut the travel down.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 scannable things with the WAiNK app. The pool is bigger than the target — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags together run well past 100 — so the winning habit is simply to scan whatever catches your eye while travelling, rather than making dedicated trips.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app by holding Up on the D-pad, then hold R1 while looking at a scannable object to scan it.
Landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags all count toward the 100.
Scan opportunistically as you travel — the world holds well over 100 scannables, so the trophy completes itself on the way to others.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Fifty of the game's 80 challenges. This one is a waypoint, not a destination: the 100% checklist wants 70, so take the 50 easiest now and know the road continues. Most challenges complete themselves as a side effect of the other trophies.

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; the checkmark at the bottom-right of a challenge shows it is done.
Track them under Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest 50 first.
Remember the 100% checklist needs 70 — this trophy pops on the way, not at the end of the road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: A two-person escape: reach four stars with your partner beside you, then break out of the red heat zone entirely — hiding inside the flashing search area is not enough. A fast bike and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the reliable route; bank-vault robberies, which always draw four stars, often hand it to you for free.

steps.text: Team up first: after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner with Right on the D-pad + Triangle.
Cause enough chaos together to reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red 'heat' zone completely — leaving only the flashing search area does not count.
Reliable route: a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot follow.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three robberies in one unbroken police chase, with your partner along. The wanted level must never fully drop between shops, so plan a tight cluster — the three jewelry stores of north Vice City are the classic route — gear up beforehand, and do not panic if the trophy lands late: its unlock trails the third shop by about half a minute.

steps.text: Call your partner (Right + Triangle, after Coffee Break) and stock up at Ammu-Nation: armored vest, sticky bombs and healing such as Zombix or Adrenaline.
Rob 3 robbery targets (green map icons) back-to-back while keeping the flashing wanted level alive the entire time.
Good ground: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a few items per store and crack each back-room safe with sticky bombs.
If nothing pops after the third shop, push on to a fourth — the unlock is delayed by roughly 30 seconds after leaving the last shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover — not drive, not own — 100 different vehicles, by scanning them with WAiNK as they pass. A busy road and a few minutes of scanning does it. The launch fleet runs to 557 vehicles and the 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so this is another trophy that pops early on a longer road.

steps.text: Hold Up to open the WAiNK app and scan vehicles as they pass; discovering is scanning, you do not need to drive them.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything new that goes by — variety is what counts.
Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles; there are 557 vehicles at launch and 100% needs 200 scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus slow-down. The focus bar drains fast, so stack the deck before you trigger it: Adrenaline to stretch the bar, body armor, a full-auto rifle, and a knot of five gang members in front of you. If the bar still feels too short, level Focus up first — it grows through ranges, sports and headshots.

steps.text: Aim a firearm and press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus, which slows time while the purple focus bar drains.
Take down 5 enemies before the bar empties; eat, drink or use Adrenaline beforehand to stretch it, and wear body armor.
Line up groups at gang operation sites with a full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 — it does not appear to work on soldiers, police or civilians.
Focus strengthens as you level it (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots); if one use feels too short, come back at Focus level 4.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet from a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport and fly it away. The detail that matters: the plane must be one docked at a terminal bridge, not a jet parked out on the apron. Terminals E3 and E4 are the easy doors in, and the trophy lands about a kilometre out — slightly delayed, so keep flying.

steps.text: At VCIA, target a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal's boarding bridge — apron-parked planes do not count.
Easiest entry is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, take the stairs by the boarding bridge, and go up to the cockpit.
Reverse the plane to the runway, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport — the unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhinos of the description are military tanks, parked at Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the map's south-west edge. Get inside the base, climb into one, and put its gun to use on enemies until the trophy pops.

steps.text: Head to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks are parked in its south.
Enter through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a Rhino tank and shoot at enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A silent jewelry robbery, and silence has a prerequisite: the Snap Gun from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which opens alarmed doors without tripping them. Back door in, find the safe-code note in the back room, empty the safe, leave unseen. Kicking the door in is the one move that ruins it.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry robberies with green icons.
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun; do not kick the door, which trips the alarm and the detection with it.
Find the note carrying the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, and leave undetected — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, each ending in a 4-star escape. The vaults unlock through one Chapter 4 optional mission built around tailing a security van; after that, a fence sells you van tips to find the rest. There are 8 large bank jobs in all and the 100% checklist wants every one, so this Silver pops on the way to the full set.

steps.text: Unlock vaults through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... — wait at the cafe, then tail a security van to its bank.
Slip in as the guard opens the vault and grab the cash; bring your partner and hand a bag off with Right on the D-pad, because you cannot carry it all.
Every vault instantly triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike and switch cars to go unrecognized.
Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple markers) to find more vaults; 8 large bank jobs exist and 100% needs all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and get away. Most players earn this without trying: the Chapter 4 mission that unlocks the bank vaults counts its truck robbery automatically. If you want it earlier, a sticky bomb on a truck's rear doors near any Vice City bank does the same job.

steps.text: The Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is... counts automatically — tailing its truck to the bank and robbing the vault is an armored-truck robbery.
For an earlier route: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius afterwards — a Pay 'n' Spray helps; sticky bombs are stocked in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map — all 52 areas of Leonida. On foot this takes forever; from the air it is one sightseeing flight. Take a plane and sweep every black patch until no fog is left anywhere.

steps.text: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida so the map is fully unfogged.
Do it by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible — far faster than driving it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One illegal operation robbed from each of Leonida's 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist eventually wants all of them, but the trophy only needs the spread: check the Gangs page, find a gang you have not hit, and rob one of theirs.

steps.text: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Operations carry yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through the story; there are 39 in total.
Track each gang's robbed operations under Progress > Gangs to see which gangs are still missing.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — stated plainly, because honesty beats invention: the description is the only hint anyone has. It points at a bar on Ocean Beach with a view and a cocktail ordered there, but no published guide has confirmed the exact bar or trigger yet. This entry claims no location; check the cited lists as the guides catch up.

steps.text: Read the description literally: find a bar on Ocean Beach with a view and order a cocktail there.
UNCONFIRMED: as of this fieldbook's writing, no published guide has confirmed the exact bar or trigger — PowerPyx still lists the trophy as unknown.
Do not trust any source that names a precise spot for this yet; re-check the cited publications as their guides are updated.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The description is a wink at the series' classic showroom escape — driving a car out through a showroom's front window — but which showroom, and what exactly triggers the award, no published guide has confirmed yet. The idea is recorded here as an idea, not as a location.

steps.text: The description suggests the classic series moment: drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's front window.
UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed which showroom or the exact trigger — PowerPyx still lists the trophy as unknown.
Treat any precise location claim for this trophy as unverified until the cited guides confirm a method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, and 'follow-through' means a robbery: lift all three key valuables from the gang operation there. The trophy does not pop at the third grab — it lands after you escape the police, so finish the getaway before you judge it. Missed an item? The operation respawns and lets you return, so this one cannot be missed.

steps.text: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation you first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.

Take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation).
Escape the police afterwards — the trophy pops on the escape, not on the third item.
If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the rest; it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Behind the coy description: maximum Strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. The trick that halves the work is training together — while one lead works out, the partner trains alongside automatically. Gyms are on the map's Activities filter, and the home gym works after the story.

steps.text: Raise Strength to maximum for both Jason and Lucia simultaneously; check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon).
Train at fitness clubs (map Activities filter, dumbbell icon) or at home after the story.
Always bring your partner (Right + Triangle): while one character trains, the other trains automatically, doubling progress — character switching unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Five hundred criminal-profile choices. Almost everything you do in a robbery or a fight nudges the profile one way or another, so this accrues passively and usually pops late on its own. Turn on the profile notifications so you can see it counting — and steer away from the one permanent outcome, Irredeemable, which makes the police far more aggressive for the rest of the game.

steps.text: Make 500 choices that affect your criminal profile; tap the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500.
Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts.
Know the scale: stealthy objectives, clean getaways and destroying evidence lean Professional; wounding without killing is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing is Psycho.
Avoid excessive violence: the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police far more aggressive — it blocks no trophy, but it taxes everything after it.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. Nobody has published a verified method for this one yet. The name and the one-line description suggest failing at something and succeeding on the second attempt, and the guides' leading guess ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — recorded here as a guess, exactly as its sources label it.

steps.text: The description hints at failing once and succeeding on the second try: 'Second time's the charm.'
UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has confirmed the unlock; the leading guess in the guides connects it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Treat that connection as a guess, not a fact, until a cited guide confirms the method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The title and the baffled description both point at witnessing something strange, and the guides' leading guess is a UFO questline — but no published method exists yet, so this entry offers the guess labelled as a guess and invents no location, time or trigger.

steps.text: The description reads like witnessing something strange: 'What the hell just happened?'
UNCONFIRMED: the leading guess in the guides is that it comes from a UFO questline; no published guide has confirmed how it unlocks.
Recorded as a guess, not a fact — check the cited publications for a confirmed method as guides are updated.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The description's plain reading is a melee knockdown delivered from a moving motorcycle — bowling enemies over as you pass — and that is also the guides' leading guess. It is not yet a confirmed method, so try it in that spirit and treat any more precise claim with suspicion until a cited guide verifies it.

steps.text: Read the description plainly: knock enemies down with a melee attack while driving past them.
UNCONFIRMED: the leading guess in the guides is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle; no published guide has confirmed the exact method.
Recorded as a guess, not a fact — the bowling name is a pun on the knockdown, not a place.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a quarter of a million dollars of marked bills, counted across every delivery rather than in one trip. The pipeline unlocks in Chapter 3: one mission hands you the Dye Pack Jammer, after which bank and Payday Loans robberies produce marked bills to fence — and Yasmani pays the best rate. Chapter 4's vaults are so rich that this finishes itself alongside the robbery trophies.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 counts across all deliveries, not a single trip; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery once they unlock in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend six figures across Leonida's shops, cumulatively — every till counts. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn money fastest, so a few serious Ammu-Nation and mod-shop sessions do most of it; the rest accrues from ordinary play.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops; the count is cumulative across every shop type.
Ammu-Nation, mod shops, Pay 'n' Sprays, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty salons, tattoo studios and electronics stores all count.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest route because they cost the most per visit.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages — $160,000 in total, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app that lands on your phone in Chapter 2. The four story garages do not count. Fund it with robberies, and note the synergy: garage spaces are what let you register vehicles for On the Spot.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), garages go on sale and the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app — $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count.
Robberies are the quickest funding, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app at Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn. Registration needs parking spots, so garages come first (see Little Boxes), and it costs money per car — feed it cheap low-end cars and bikes. Early on Moses only takes tracker-free vehicles; from Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Sprays can register standard-tracker cars too.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses), who works out of Port Gellhorn.
Buy garages first — each adds parking spots you need before you can register more vehicles.
Drive stolen cars to Moses and choose Respray and Register in his garage; use cheap low-end cars and bikes, since registering costs money.
He only takes vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
